_comment: FROZEN CONTRACT, published as part of elowen-plugin-shared so that both sides of the cron/schedule grammar read the SAME file rather than two copies with a promise. The grammar is hand-mirrored in three implementations that cannot import one another: the cronjob plugin's parseSchedule (the authority, and what validates API writes), web/lib/cronSchedule.ts and web/lib/cron.ts. The daemon checks its web copies against this file; the plugin registry checks the plugin against this same file, resolved from the installed package. Widening the grammar means editing it here and shipping a new version of this package — which is the point: drift stops being possible instead of merely being forbidden.
